pages.text: $(bold)Artillery Scope$()$(br2)Right-click while holding a cannon to enter scope mode for precision aiming.$(br2)$(bold)Features:$()$(br)• Magnified view for long-range targeting$(br)• Crosshair for precise aim$(br)• Ballistic prediction line$(br)• Range estimation

$(bold)Controls:$()$(br)• Right-click: Enter scope mode$(br)• Mouse: Adjust aim$(br)• Scroll wheel: Adjust zoom level$(br)• Left-click: Fire$(br)• Right-click or Esc: Exit scope$(br2)$(bold)Tip:$() Scope mode reduces spread and improves accuracy. Use for long-range engagements!
